title: LinkedIn Job Finder
description: Search public LinkedIn job listings. No login or cookies needed.

keywords.title: Job keywords
keywords.description: One or more search phrases, for example "data engineer" or "product manager". Each keyword is searched in every location.
keywords.sectionDescription: What to look for and where.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City, region or country names as you would type them on LinkedIn, for example "Berlin" or "United States". Defaults to United States.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Only jobs posted within this window.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order LinkedIn uses for the search results.

maxJobsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search
maxJobsPerSearch.description: Maximum jobs collected for each keyword and location pair. LinkedIn's public search returns roughly 1,000 results per search at most.

workTypes.title: Workplace type
workTypes.sectionDescription: Narrow the results. Title and company filters run before details are fetched, so rejected jobs cost nothing.

easyApplyOnly.title: Easy Apply only
easyApplyOnly.description: Only jobs that can be applied to directly on LinkedIn.

titleInclude.title: Title must contain (any of)
titleInclude.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains at least one of these words. Case-insensitive.

titleExclude.title: Title must NOT contain
titleExclude.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these words, for example "intern" or "junior".

companyExclude.title: Exclude companies
companyExclude.description: Drop jobs from companies whose name contains any of these words.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch job details
fetchDetails.description: ON (default): opens each job to get the full description, the application link, the extracted requirements, skills and years of experience. OFF: fast mode with title, company, location, date and salary only.

compact.title: Compact output
compact.description: Core fields only, without the full description. Ideal for AI agents and automations that pay per token.

excludeEmptyFields.title: Exclude empty fields
excludeEmptyFields.description: Drop null, empty text and empty list fields from each result.

incrementalMode.title: Only new jobs (incremental mode)
incrementalMode.description: Remember every job already delivered and return only jobs you have not seen before. Ideal for scheduled daily runs: you are only charged for new jobs.
incrementalMode.sectionDescription: Run on a schedule and receive only what is new.

stateKey.title: State key (optional)
stateKey.description: Name that identifies this tracked search, for example "berlin-data-jobs". Leave empty to derive it automatically from your search settings, so different searches never share memory.

telegramToken.title: Telegram bot token
telegramToken.description: From @BotFather. Needs the chat ID below.
telegramToken.sectionDescription: Get a digest of new jobs after each run. Failures never fail the run.

telegramChatId.title: Telegram chat ID
telegramChatId.description: Chat or channel ID, for example -100123456789.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (n8n, Make, Zapier, custom)
webhookUrl.description: Receives a JSON POST with the new jobs after each run.

notificationLimit.title: Jobs per chat message
notificationLimit.description: How many jobs to list in each Telegram, Slack or Discord message (1-20).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. If you see blocked requests, switch to the RESIDENTIAL proxy group.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Only change these if you hit blocks or want to go slower.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Minimum pause between requests. Higher is slower but gentler and less likely to be blocked.

detailConcurrency.title: Parallel detail fetches
detailConcurrency.description: How many job detail pages to fetch at once. Keep low (1-2) to reduce block risk.

saveSampleHtml.title: Save sample HTML (debugging)
saveSampleHtml.description: Stores one raw search page and one raw job page in the key-value store (SAMPLE_SEARCH_PAGE, SAMPLE_DETAIL_PAGE). Useful for reporting a parsing problem.
